paragraphs: Bava Metzia 68a: Rav Ashi said, “The elders of Mata Mechasya told me.”[^1]

notes.text: Rav Ashi is explicit; the elders of Mata Mechasya are a collective, not a named personal title or authority. They told Rav Ashi, in that direction. 68a follows the period convention without a named verifying witness; Mata is the inherited place rendering of the older town of formulation.
